caption:
I've coached grassroots football since my son was in the under 9s. Every Saturday the same thing. The squad in one place, the shape on a magnet board, the subs on the back of a teamsheet and the minutes in my head.

So I built the board I wanted. Gafferboard. Squad, who's in, the shape, the bench and every sub to the minute, on your phone. Then who's in goes to the parents' group, in your name.

It's free for your team. No account, nothing to install.

If you coach, have a go before the weekend and tell me what's missing. I read every message.

- Davide
